_about: F60 (Muzzy, sprint 08 retro: 'that render shader should be accessible to apply to things in the future, and should feel pretty simple/fast to apply'): the CRT look as presets any panel can take — <CrtLook preset="dos"> or <CrtLook place="monitor"> (src/game/CrtLook.tsx). First built for the console monitor (F32: 'make it look like old DOS'). Looks only: nothing here changes a rule. Each preset switches its layers on or off (tint, glow, scan lines, wobble, typing) and holds their knobs. 'use' = which preset each place on screen wears (a dropdown, live). The monitor's screen stays dark blue (content/ui/art.json console.crt) and the font stays the game's. Reduce motion: the words show at once, the cursor holds still, no wobble, no rolling. Scan-line knobs mean the same as the x-ray box's (cracks-look.json xray.scan*): gap = from one line to the next, width = a line's thickness, alpha = how dark, speed = how fast they roll down.

_help.use.monitor: Which preset the console's monitor wears (its own words and a lesson's lines).
_help.use.nextWindow: Which preset the next-piece window wears (scan lines over the piece; F60 task 12, the second place).
_help.presets.dos.tint: Colour the words (text colour). Off = the panel's own text colour.
_help.presets.dos.scanLines: Dark scan lines over the whole panel (words too).
_help.presets.dos.wobble: Now and then the words jitter sideways (phase wobble). Off with reduce motion.
_help.presets.dos.typing: The words type out letter by letter with a block cursor. Off = all there at once, no cursor.
_help.presets.dos.lettersPerSecond: How fast the words type out (letters per second). New words type again from the start.
_help.presets.dos.cursorBlinkSeconds: One blink of the block cursor: on, then off (seconds). 0 = it holds still.
_help.presets.dos.cursorWidth: The block cursor's width (1 = as wide as the letters are tall).
_help.presets.dos.glowSize: How far the glow spreads (1 = a letter's height).
_help.presets.dos.glowStrength: How strong the glow is (0 = none, 1 = full).
_help.presets.dos.scanGap: Scan lines: from one line to the next (the place's units: the console monitor counts in its art units, its screen is about 540 wide; elsewhere px).
_help.presets.dos.scanWidth: Scan lines: how thick each dark line is (same units as the gap).
_help.presets.dos.scanAlpha: How dark the scan lines are (0 = none, 1 = black).
_help.presets.dos.scanSpeed: How fast the scan lines roll down (units per second; 0 = still). Stops with reduce motion.
_help.presets.dos.wobbleSize: Phase wobble: how far the words jitter sideways (1 = a letter's height).
_help.presets.dos.wobbleSeconds: How often the wobble comes round (seconds).
_help.presets.amber.tint: amber = an old amber monitor; its knobs mean the same as dos's.
_help.presets.off.tint: off = every layer switched off: the panel looks as it would without the look (its knobs wait, unused, for a layer switched back on).
